fault_mask_interpretation: Row-by-channel oracle injection mask used only to test conditional controller response; not a validated field fault detector.
conditional_fault_policy: Water depth is critical for every stage. Soil moisture is critical outside flowering; faults in other measured channels allow the explicit AWD rule to continue in degraded mode.
safe_mode_behavior: Hold the previous gate command and flag manual review.
controller_authority: The configured synthetic AWD policy controls valid readings; the Random Forest action is advisory only.
awd_policy: During flowering, request open below 2 cm; otherwise request open at or below -15 cm or at soil moisture at or below 25%.
